channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: MK Website Assistant Review (2026): AI Enquiry Bot From £39/mo
item.description: MK Website Assistant: AI Assistant Plus also costs from £290 and then £59 a month. Prices are "from" amounts, so the final set-up fee can be higher.

item.title: VideoUpload Review (2026): YouTube Team Board From $20/mo
item.description: VideoUpload charges one flat price per workspace, with no per-seat fees. AI writing uses credits that reset monthly; extra credits are a paid top-up.

item.title: Orateur Review (2026): AI Phone Receptionist From CHF 49/mo
item.description: Orateur prices by plan, each with an allowance of AI agent time. The site is in French only and prices are in Swiss francs.

item.title: Ploy Review (2026): AI Website Builder, Free to $300/mo
item.description: Ploy: The Free tier costs $0, needs no card and includes 2,000 credits (the plan card says 500 credits a day, up to 2,000).

item.title: PrintSage Review (2026): US Print on Demand, No Subscription
item.description: PrintSage has no subscription and no plan price. Production and shipping are US-only: six US fulfillment centers, no overseas production.

item.title: Hablaki Review (2026): Local Dictation for Mac and Windows
item.description: Hablaki sells one thing: a lifetime licence for $9.99, paid once, with no subscription and no account. Refunds are standard only within 14 days of purchase.

item.title: Petty Cash Manager Review (2026): From $3.50/mo Billed Yearly
item.description: Petty Cash Manager: 3 months is $16.99 ($5.66 a month) on 3 devices. Without the Cloud sync add-on, your records live in the browser on each device.

item.title: Acronis True Image Review (2026): €49.99/yr, Cloud on Advanced
item.description: Acronis: For 1 computer it is €124.99 a year with 1 TB of cloud storage and goes up to €559.99 a year with 10 TB. Essentials has no cloud storage at all.

item.title: Teachable Review (2026): Plans From $39/mo, 7.5% Fee on Starter
item.description: Teachable: Builder is $89 a month, or $69 billed annually. Starter takes 7.5% of every sale on top of the $39 plan.

item.title: Slasify Review (2026): EOR From $250, Contractors From $50
item.description: Slasify: Three services, each with a starting price and a custom quote. Only starting prices are public.

item.title: Compass Review (2026): Meta Ads ROAS for Shopify, $49 a Month
item.description: Compass: $49 a month, or $490 a year. The privacy policy names OpenAI among the services that receive your inputs.

item.title: NexGen Virtual Office Review (2026): Hybrid Teams, $15-$25 a User
item.description: NexGen Virtual Office: Enterprise customers, which the page describes as 1,000 or more seats, have to book a demo. We found no current free trial.

item.title: Sucuri Review (2026): Website Firewall and Cleanup, From $229/yr
item.description: Sucuri sells per website. Pricing is per site, so costs climb quickly for agencies, and plans for 10 or more sites have no published price.

item.title: XSDHub Review: Hands-on XML Tests, Pricing & Limits (2026)
item.description: Our own XML validator, tested with broken and corrected examples. XSDHub pricing, privacy, XSD 1.0 limits and what we have not tested. Ownership disclosed.

item.title: EditEngine Review (2026): Shopify Bulk Editor, Free to $49.99
item.description: EditEngine has a free plan and three paid plans, and every plan allows unlimited bulk edit, import and export tasks.

item.title: Lensmor Review (2026): Trade-Show Leads on Credits, From $499
item.description: Lensmor: 10,000 for $249, 25,000 for $549 or 60,000 for $1,199, valid for 12 months. The entry price is high: $499 a month for Basic.

item.title: pCloud Review (2026): Lifetime Cloud Storage From €219 Once
item.description: pCloud: Premium 500 GB is €219 (struck through from €279). Client-side encryption is not included in personal plans; it is a separate €150 purchase.

item.title: Yaps Review (2026): On-Device Dictation, Pro $144 a Year
item.description: Yaps Pro covers the desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux and costs $144 a year (shown as $12 a month) or $15 billed month to month.

item.title: Design.com Review (2026): Logo Maker, One Logo per Subscription
item.description: Design.com: Starter (Logo Pack) typically US$25 a month, Value (Logo Pack + Website) typically US$34 a month. Each subscription covers one logo.

item.title: Froonze Review (2026): Shopify Loyalty, Free Under 100 Orders
item.description: Froonze: Free, then $10, $20 and $40 by order volume. Modular pricing is cheap per plugin but adds up.

item.title: Landbot Review (2026): No-Code Chatbots, Free Plan, Starter €32
item.description: Landbot: Free is €0 for 100 chats a month, one seat, the full builder and templates. Starter keeps Landbot branding and has no own WhatsApp number.

item.title: Netart Review (2026): CloudHosting, $18.75 Promo First Term
item.description: Netart sells a broad range of cloud services. The headline offers are first-period promotions; after them you pay the standard $18.75, $37.50 or $75 a…

item.title: Recruit CRM Review (2026): Agency ATS and CRM, From €79 a User
item.description: Recruit CRM: Pro is €79 per user a month billed annually or €95 monthly, with 100 credits per user a month. The headline seat price is not the whole bill.

item.title: Visibility Mesh Review (2026): Shopify AI Search Audits, From $29
item.description: Visibility Mesh: Three plans, billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days, each with a 7-day free trial that includes one full scan.

item.title: Brandify Review (2026): AI Visibility Service, From $479 a Month
item.description: Brandify: Google Search management is $250 a month plus $250 setup on every plan. You pay for a monthly work allowance, not for results.

item.title: CrossLoop Review (2026): A Launch Video From a URL, $9 a Film
item.description: CrossLoop — No subscription: you buy one-time credit packs. The money-back guarantee covers only your first purchase, and films are deleted after 30 days.

item.title: Try You Review (2026): AI Try-On With No Monthly Fee, From $0.04
item.description: Try You: Free to install with 10 free try-ons, then pay per successful try-on with no monthly subscription. The cost scales with use, not with sales.

item.title: RoverLead Review (2026): Signal-Led Outreach From $149 a User
item.description: RoverLead has two self-serve plans, both priced per user. RoverLead automates outreach on LinkedIn.

item.title: FineVoice Review (2026): Audio Toolkit From $8.99 a Month
item.description: FineVoice has a free plan and three paid tiers. Monthly and annual Ultra are different products: annual Ultra is listed as Unlimited for almost every tool.

item.title: Liltio Review (2026): Local Mac Dictation, $49 Once
item.description: Liltio: $49 standard price, with no recurring subscription. Speech recognition is local, but if you switch on a configured remote AI for text transforms.
